scope: Independently inspected authored static six-view vehicle concept proposal only
method: Actual full-sheet image viewing; meaningful detail crops as enumerated. No generated score or claimed pixel-similarity measurement.
stronger_reference_gate: Not a final reference-sensitive asset/integration approval. Existing >=9.9 and exact-10 production requirements remain active.
untested: Native editable mesh and full 360 geometry
Full tool motion cycles and load/contact transitions
Driving, fuel use, resource custody, combat, audio and device performance
observations: All six panels inspected. Studio views show three axles and six wheels, a white/blue front cabin, one orange crane, rear bed, one relay module plus ordinary supply crate, roof dish and distinct rear lamps.
AT WORK shows one held relay module over a socket and no second module left on deck; the ordinary supply crate stays aboard. The scene is firm alien terrain with no free levitation or laser effect.

defects.location: AT WORK versus studio profiles and THREE-QUARTER
defects.finding: The working truck has a shortened two-axle/four-wheel chassis; only two near-side wheels fit under it. All studio views specify three axles/six wheels.
defects.repair: Base the work-panel chassis and full-length bed on THREE-QUARTER, retaining all three grounded axles while deploying the crane.

defects.location: AT WORK versus studio travel views
defects.finding: Working clamp uses orange outer jaws/black pads instead of the depicted silver two-prong head. Two working outriggers appear along the near side, while travel views depict one side mount and authored text says two total.
defects.repair: Use the same silver two-prong head rotated onto the module. Keep consistent one-per-side stabilizer mounts; a far-side leg may be partly occluded. Record any deliberate new support design explicitly.
